notes: Exchange Extravaganza: per-quest defaults for free-to-play accounts, and the three artifact quests are done by Apex - opening the regular artifact chest with artifact coins, upgrading and enhancing artifacts, never with gems. Increase Might (Artifacts) can go by upgrade, enhance or both, strongest or cheapest artifact first. The Speed Ups quest spends speed-ups only on the timers you choose. Train Soldiers trains T1 without speed-ups. The quest driver still starts in Watch mode until an account is switched to Act.
